texts.zh: 这个郁郁葱葱的文明与太空生物群形成了独特的协同作用。通过向这些生物提供果实，他们吸引种子传播者来帮助它们进行殖民。
texts.en: This verdant civilization has developed a unique synergy with spaceborne fauna. By offering their fruits to these creatures, they entice the seed dispersers to aid their colonization efforts.

sections.zh:
如果你的根扎得很深，而你的精神却变得焦躁不安，那就让别人替你分担痛苦吧。让动物们轻嗅你的花朵，以果实之给养和树影之阴翳加以馈赠。便让它们把花粉和种子带到远方，好让你的后代在异星的土地上生根发芽。当风中传来叶语婆娑，便知你的游子已寻见了新家。

自古以来，我们就与当地的动物合作，将我们的物种传播到[GetHomeWorldName]各地。所以，当我们将要离开故土，将树枝伸向天空时，我们自然也会与虚空中的动物群联系在一起。让他们啃食我们的水果，咀嚼我们的枝叶。然后让它们将把我们的孩子带到遥远的星球，在那里，他们将在外星的阳光下茁壮成长。

愿我们播种四方，愿星系成为我们的花园。
sections.en:
If your roots run deep, yet your spirit grows restless, let others carry your aches away. Let animals sniff your flowers, nourish themselves on your fruits, and bathe in the shadow of your leaves. Let them carry pollen and seeds to distant lands, so that your offspring can bury their roots on foreign soil. And when the wind brings you the sound of rustling leaves, you'll know your children have found a new home.

Since time immemorial, we have worked with local fauna to spread our species across [GetHomeWorldName]. So when the time came to uproot ourselves, branches reaching further skyward, it was only natural we would also connect with the fauna of the void. They chew our fruits. They graze our leaves. And they'll carry our children to distant worlds, where they will bloom and be nurtured by alien suns.

Let our seeds spread. Let the galaxy be our garden.

sections.zh:
如果你的菌丝扎得很深，而你的精神却变得焦躁不安，那就让别人替你分担痛苦吧。让动物们轻嗅你的孢子，以菌杆之给养和菌盖之阴翳加以馈赠。便让它们把孢子带到远方，好让你的后代在异星的土地上生根发芽。当大地中传来菌网呢喃，便知你的游子已寻见了新家。

自古以来，我们就与当地的动物合作，将我们的物种传播到[GetHomeWorldName]各地。所以，当我们将要离开故土，将菌柄伸向天空时，我们自然也会与虚空中的动物群联系在一起。让他们啃食我们的子实体，咀嚼我们的菌褶。然后让它们将把我们的孩子带到遥远的星球，在那里，他们将在外星的土壤中茁壮成长。

愿我们播种四方，愿星系成为我们的蘑菇花园。
sections.en:
If your mycelia run deep, yet your spirit grows restless, let others carry your aches away. Let animals sniff your spores, nourish themselves on your stalks, and bathe in the shadow of your mushroom caps. Let them carry spores to distant lands, so that your offspring can bury their roots on foreign soil. And when the earths brings you the thrums of a new mycorrhizal network, you'll know your children have found a home.

Since time immemorial, we have worked with local fauna to spread our species across [GetHomeWorldName]. So when the time came to uproot ourselves, toadstools reaching further skyward, it was only natural we would also connect with the fauna of the void. They chew our fruiting bodies. They graze our gills. And they'll carry our children to distant worlds, where they will bloom and be nurtured by alien suns.

Let our spores spread. Let the galaxy be our mushroom garden.

texts.zh:
缇扬奇是我们最先遇到的外星物种，关于这种温顺的生物我们已经了解了很多。

这种太空生物可以访问某种较为低维度的亚空间，所以他们能轻易地在星系间穿行。他们以许多气态行星上层大气中的气体为食，但已经喜欢上了我们的果实。他们即便在受到惊扰的情况下几乎不会发起攻击。

这就是我们种子的完美载体：平静、无害甚至有点无聊。他们隐藏着什么秘密吗？
texts.en:
The Tiyanki are the first alien species we encountered, and we already learned much about these docile creatures.

Capable of accessing some lower dimension of subspace, these spaceborne lifeforms roam from system to system with remarkable ease. They graze on gases common to the upper layers of many gas giants, but have taken a liking to our fruits. They will rarely, if ever, attack, even when provoked.

The perfect carrier for our seeds: calm, innocuous, almost boring. Do they hide any secret?

这种太空生物可以访问某种较为低维度的亚空间，所以他们能轻易地在星系间穿行。他们以许多气态行星上层大气中的气体为食，但已经喜欢上了我们的果实。他们即便在受到惊扰的情况下几乎不会发起攻击。

这就是我们种子的完美载体：平静、无害甚至有点无聊。他们隐藏着什么秘密吗？
texts.en:
The Tiyanki are a new alien species we encountered, and we already learned much about these docile creatures.

Capable of accessing some lower dimension of subspace, these spaceborne lifeforms roam from system to system with remarkable ease. They graze on gases common to the upper layers of many gas giants, but have taken a liking to our fruits. They will rarely, if ever, attack, even when provoked.

The perfect carrier for our seeds: calm, innocuous, almost boring. Do they hide any secret?

label.zh: 把更多的时间花在他们的研究上。
label.en: Dedicate further time to their study.

label.zh: 我们还有更要紧的事情。

notes.zh: 本起源的主线很短（缇扬奇观察）；其余内容是由玩法状态（喂食、种子、战争、议案）触发的独立事件。
notes.en: The scripted story is short (the Tiyanki study); the rest are independent events fired by gameplay state (feeding, seeds, war, resolutions).

texts.zh: 把一些空间站人员投入到对缇扬奇的研究中，可以让我们进一步了解这些宁静而神秘的太空生物的习性。
texts.en: Dedicating some space station personnel to the study of the Tiyankis could give us further insights into the life of these pacific, mysterious voidborne creatures.

texts.zh: 通过对这些太空朋友进食习性的研究，我们的科学家获得了研究突破。改进缇扬奇提取气态物质的能量的方法，就有可能造出可以从敌方舰船中汲取能量的武器。。这项科技毫无疑问是非常有用的。
texts.en: By studying the feeding habits of our voidborne friends, our scientists have made a scientific breakthrough. Adapting the Tiyanki method of siphoning energy from gaseous matter, it is possible to construct weapons draining energy from enemy ships.. This technology will doubtlessly prove useful.

label.zh: 棒极了。
缇扬奇研究完成

texts.zh: 我们在[this.GetName]的殖民地正在被超授粉的种子球轰炸。森林在世界各地快速增生，地面撕裂、建筑倒毁，[this.GetPlanetHabitat]上现在到处都是迅速生长的外星植物。
texts.en: Our colony on [this.GetName] is being bombarded with hyper-fertilized balls of seeds. New forests are sprouting everywhere, cracking floors, ruining buildings and filling the [this.GetPlanetHabitat] with rapid-growing xenoflora.

label.zh: 令人不安。

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, this planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
我们为星系的太空生物群建造了一座花园。我们让其中开满了鲜花，结满了果实和黏性的种荚，时刻准备着附着在这些令人惊叹的生物的皮肤上。但这些深居虚空的生灵们会出席我们的盛宴吗？当他们咬下第一口果实时，所有的担忧便已烟消云散。

从记事起，我们就已经在自己的星球上为各种动物提供果实与荫蔽。作为回报，它们替我们携带种子。如今，这一古老的契约被翻印到了星系的尺度上：太空生物将携带着我们的种荚一同旅行。只要运气尚佳，我们的种子将会落在一颗可殖民行星上，并找到为我们的人民建造一座新花园所需的一切。我们只需要引导一道能量束将他们激活，就可以让我们无需派遣殖民船便可以定居到新的行星上。
texts.en:
For the galaxy's spaceborne fauna, we built a garden. We filled it with flowers, fruit and sticky seed pods, ready to latch to the skin of these magnificent creatures. But would these void-dwellers appreciate our banquet? As soon as they bit the first apple, our anxiety dissipated.

Since time immemorial, we have offered fruit and shade to the animals on our planet. In return, they carried our seeds. Now, this ancient pact has been replicated at a galactic scale: spaceborne fauna will carry our Seed Pods with them as they travel. With a little luck, our seeds will fall on a colonizable planet where they will have everything they need to establish a new garden for our people. We need only direct an energy beam to activate them, allowing us to inhabit new planets without having to send a colony ship.

label.zh: 棒极了。

texts.zh:
太空兽群虽然能帮我们散播种荚，但还是不如最近加入舰队的新成员来得靠谱。

我们的星种花园会给麾下的生物分发种子，然后我们就能直接派它们前往适合殖民的星球，在那里开辟出新的花园。
texts.en:
Though we can rely on wild space fauna to spread our Seed Pods, we can do so more reliably with those who have recently joined our fleets.

Our Starseed Gardens will distribute seeds to creatures within our fold, whom we can then send directly to colonizable planets to establish a new garden.

label.zh: 棒极了。

texts.zh:
[this.GetName]上的土壤里散落着似乎不属于当地生态系统的种子。在最低限度的光照和水分下，种子迅速地生长，新生的森林迅速包裹了整个行星，促进了我们的殖民活动。

据基因分析，这些特别的种子是由[seeds_owner.GetName]研发的。
texts.en:
The soil of [this.GetName] is littered by seed that don't appear to be part of the local ecosystem. With minimal amount of light and water, the seeds quickly developed, enveloping the planet in new forest and aiding our colonization efforts.

According to our genetic analysis, these unusual seeds have been developed by the [seeds_owner.GetName].

texts.zh:

得益于这些种荚中的通讯系统，我们可以很快与这些种子的发源地帝国建立联络。
texts.en:
The soil of [this.GetName] is littered by seed that don't appear to be part of the local ecosystem. With minimal amount of light and water, the seeds quickly developed, enveloping the planet in new forest and aiding our colonization efforts.

Thanks to the communication system in the seed pods, we were able to quickly establish contact with the empire the seed germinated from.

With minimal amount of light and water, the seeds quickly developed, enveloping the planet in new forest and aiding our colonization efforts.. Our scientists have been unable to determine the origin of the seeds, but one thing is certain: they are artificial in nature, bio-engineered to quickly take root in alien soil.

祝愿他们根深叶茂。
texts.en:
Our colony ship just landed [from.GetName], but our people were already there, lying dormant in the soil. The additional [root.owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] and resources contained in the Seed Pod will help our colonists develop the planet.

May their roots spread far and wide.

texts.zh: 我们与太空生物的关系相当独特，但我们并不是唯一尊重它们生存权的人。星海共同体刚刚通过的一项议案将有助于保护这些奇妙生物。
texts.en: Our relationship with spaceborne creatures is fairly unique, but we are not alone in respecting their right to exist; a resolution that has just passed in the Galactic Community will help protect the lives of these wondrous creatures.

label.zh: 棒极了。

texts.zh: 太空生物一直是我们的朋友，但并非所有的星海共同体成员都像我们一样热爱这些太空生物。他们刚刚通过的决议将我们的朋友——以及我们自己——的生命置于危险之中。
texts.en: Spaceborne creatures have always be our friends, but not all members of the Galactic Community share our love for the void-dwellers. The resolution they just passed puts the livelihood of our friends - and ours - at a risk.

label.zh: 棒极了。

texts.zh:
我们的敌人认为我们会屈服于他们的力量，就像被风吹倒的芦苇一样。他们忘记了植物有刺。

我们的士兵睡在他们的土地上。如果有需要，我们可以将我们的外星入侵植物转变为陆军，保护我们的一切，扼杀他们所谓的他们拥有的东西。我们只需将能量束引导到指定的行星即可开始我们的入侵行动。
texts.en:
Our enemies think we will bend to their strength, like reeds blown down by the wind. They forget that plants have thorns.

Our soldiers sleep in their ground. Should the need arise, we can turn our Invasive Xenoflora into armies, to protect what is ours and to strangle what they call their own. We need only to direct an energy beam to the desired planet in order to begin our invasion.

label.zh: 棒极了。

texts.zh: 战争时期，我们的种荚可以绽放成为陆军，随时保卫我们的殖民地或者入侵遥远的目标。
texts.en: In times of war, our Seed Pods can blossom into armies, ready to defend our colonies or to invade distant targets.

texts.zh: 我们的种荚被太空兽群带到了[this.GetName]，他们在此处得到了[this.owner.GetName]的栽培和照料。通过向行星发射一道聚能光束，可以将这片森林转变为外星植物军。这颗行星上外星入侵植物的等级越高，就会生成越多的陆军。
texts.en: Space Fauna have brought our Seed Pods to [this.GetName] where they were cultivated and cared for by the [this.owner.GetName]. By aiming a concentrated energy beam towards the planet, we can stimulate growth, turning the forest into Xenofloran Armies. The higher the level of the Invasive Xenoflora on the planet, the more armies will be spawned.

summary.text:
# 硕果协作 / Fruitful Partnership

- 分类 Category：起源 Origins · DLC：Plantoids

## 如何开始 How it starts

开局设置之后，origin.7000“缇扬奇”在 1800–3600 天后出现：启用项目“缇扬奇观测”，完成后 7005 收束。
After game start origin.7000 appears 1800-3600 days later: it enables the Tiyanki Observation project, which ends in 7005.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

主线很短；起源玩法由状态触发的独立事件组成：
The scripted story is short; the rest are independent events fired by gameplay state.

1. **缇扬奇观察**：7000 → 项目 → 7005。 Tiyanki study: 7000 -> project -> 7005.
2. **种子与喂食**：首次播种轰炸（7201）、被引诱的生物吃种（7100）、生物携带种子（7304）、种子落在已有人的星球（7327 / 项目“打开种荚”→ 7321）、他国或己方在带种子星球殖民（7326 / 7328）、种荚前哨站（7400）。 Seeds and feeding tutorials and outcomes.
3. **外交与战争**：星海共同体保护法案（7500）或害虫防治法案（7510）；战争开始时 7600 → 事件链“战争之种”与项目“培育军队” → 7710。 Galactic Community acts (7500 / 7510); on war 7600 -> chain and the Grow Armies project -> 7710.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

无固定结局；7500 / 7510 互斥。 No fixed ending; 7500 / 7510 are exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

大部分窗口仅在拥有种子或喂食站时出现。 Most windows need seeds or a feeding station.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/origin_events_5.txt:1-1300`、`common/special_projects/00_projects_plantoids.txt`、`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt`
- 本导读是审阅者的说明文字，不是游戏原文。 This guide is reviewer commentary, not game text.
- 已核对 Checked：origin.7000–7710 窗口与钩子。 Windows 7000-7710 and hooks.
- 更正 Corrections：所有状态入口加标签，互斥组标注。 Entries labelled, exclusive groups marked.
- 不确定 Uncertain：隐藏的种子机制事件仅读取了触发钩子。 Hidden seed mechanics read for hooks only.
- r3-integrate（2026-10-13）：并入事件链概览卡“散布种子”（无可读窗口，仅名称与图片；见 common/event_chains/00_event_chains_3.txt:125-129，由 fruitful_start_effect 于开局开启 01_start_of_game_effects.txt:4192）。
  r3-integrate (2026-10-13): Absorbed the event-chain overview card Seed Dispersal (no readable window, name and picture only; common/event_chains/00_event_chains_3.txt:125-129, begun at game start by fruitful_start_effect 01_start_of_game_effects.txt:4192).
